digest.component_or_area: reconciler bridge status and canary heartbeat
propositions: Canonical `rebar bridge status` and hidden alias `rebar bridge-status` must expose identical read-only entrypoints with same parser, core, options, output, errors, and exits

Durable writer records minimal authoritative JSON (schema, pass id, environment id, outcome, failure kind, completion time, fence) to refs/reconciler/last-pass before releasing refs/reconciler/lock using three-attempt force-with-lease CAS with 100/200 ms retry backoff
Status verdict total precedence is PAUSED > RUNNING > FOREIGN > FAILED > STALE > HEALTHY with NEVER_RUN only when no record and no live lock; missing/unreadable .env-id is a hard configuration error

Canary performs two read-only live-fence snapshots across lock-carried lease to detect CRASHED state; defaults to status source and makes no heartbeat API query on canonical path while preserving explicit github-api rollback for one release

Identity derivation: explicit REBAR_ENV_ID wins, otherwise local:<repo-env-id> from .env-id for writer and status; inbound event metadata and LEGACY_JIRA_ENV_ID remain unchanged; reconcile workflow continues supplying reconciler identity

Rich detail is one rolling .bridge_state/last-pass.json file; status includes detail only when pass and environment ids match authoritative ref; duplicate producers and dead baseline fields are removed after semantic and string reference sweeps
